newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S DOWNHILL WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S DOWNHILL WINNER.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of Fritz Strobl, the winner of a men's Alpine skiing World Cup downhill on Saturday:
Overall World Cup wins: 2 (both downhills): Val D'Isere (96), Kitzbuehel (97)

Other facts - Strobl, a police corporal, was considered an up-and-coming downhill star in 1991 before completely smashing his left knee in a fall during a Continental Cup race in Canada. He won the super-G Europacup last winter to guarantee himself a super-G place in the World Cup this year. Coaches gave Strobl one last chance to prove himself in downhill this winter and he replied by winning the first event in Val D'Isere.
